reference_source.note: Reference is detector-derived, not field ground truth. Only dense high-confidence cells and strong empty cells are used.

grid.positive_rule: HIGH tree count >= 10 within 10 m cell
grid.negative_rule: all detected tree count == 0 and nearest detected tree >= 12 m
grid.spatial_split: 50 m blocks; SHA1(block_id) mod 5 == 0 is holdout

sampling.strategy: deterministic spatial block split + hash subsample
